arxiv-1805-06291.title: Categoricity and multidimensional diagrams Thanks: This is paper 842 in the first author archive. The first author would like to thank the Israel Science Foundation for partial support of this research (Grant No. 242/03) and the European Research Council grant 338821, and the National Science Founda
arxiv-1805-06291.creator: Saharon Shelah, Sebastien Vasey
arxiv-1805-06291.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Saharon Shelah, Sebastien Vasey. We study multidimensional diagrams in independent amalgamation in the framework of abstract elementary classes (AECs). We use them to prove the eventual categoricity conjecture for AECs, assuming a large cardinal axiom. More precisely, we show assuming the existence of a proper class of strongly compact cardinals that an AEC which has a single model of some high-enough cardinality will have a single model in any high-enough cardinal.

arxiv-1906-04927.title: A Method for Evaluating Definite Integrals in terms of Special Functions with Examples Thanks: This research is supported by NSERC Canada under Grant 504070
arxiv-1906-04927.creator: Robert Reynolds, Allan Stauffer
arxiv-1906-04927.description: Abstract . We present a method using contour integration to derive definite integrals and their associated infinite sums which can be expressed as a special function. We give a proof of the basic equation and some examples of the method.

arxiv-2111-14848.title: Diagnosing DASH: A Catalog of Structural Properties for the COSMOS-DASH Survey Journal: the Astrophysical Journal
arxiv-2111-14848.creator: Sam E. Cutler, Katherine E. Whitaker, Lamiya A. Mowla, Gabriel B. Brammer, Arjen van der Wel, Danilo Marchesini, Pieter G. van Dokkum, Ivelina G. Momcheva, Mimi Song, Mohammad Akhshik, Erica J. Nelson, Rachel Bezanson, Marijn Franx, Mariska Kriek, Joel Leja, John W. MacKenty, Adam Muzzin, Heath Ship
arxiv-2111-14848.description: Abstract We present the H 160 H_{\mathrm{160}} morphological catalogs for the COSMOS-DASH survey, the largest area near-IR survey using HST-WFC3 to date. Utilizing the “Drift And SHift” observing technique for HST-WFC3 imaging, the COSMOS-DASH survey imaged approximately 0.5 deg 2 of the UltraVISTA deep stripes (0.7 deg 2 when combined with archival data).

arxiv-2201-05802.title: Submarine Cable Network Design for Regional Connectivity
arxiv-2201-05802.creator: Tianjiao Wang, Zengfu Wang, Bill Moran, Moshe Zukerman
arxiv-2201-05802.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tianjiao Wang, Zengfu Wang, Bill Moran, Moshe Zukerman. This paper optimizes path planning for a trunk-and-branch topology network in an irregular 2-dimensional manifold embedded in 3-dimensional Euclidean space with application to submarine cable network planning.

arxiv-2203-05282.title: Volume of a dislocation network
arxiv-2203-05282.creator: Max Boleininger, Sergei L. Dudarev, Daniel R. Mason, Enrique Martínez
arxiv-2203-05282.description: Abstract We derive a simple analytical line integral expression for the relaxation volume tensor of an arbitrary interconnected dislocation network. This quantity determines the magnitude of dislocation contribution to the dimensional changes and volumetric swelling of a material, and highlights the fundamental dual role of dislocations as sources of internal strain as well as carriers of plastic deformation.

arxiv-2204-11323.title: A note on Pontryagin duality and continuous logic
arxiv-2204-11323.creator: Nicolas Chavarria, Anand Pillay

More specifically, given an abelian topological group A A , and ℱ \mathcal{F} the family (group) of continuous homomorphisms from A A to the circle group 𝕋 \mathbb{T} , then, viewing ( A , + ) (A,+) equipped with the collection ℱ \mathcal{F} as a continuous logic structure M M , we show that the local type space S ℱ ​ ( M )

arxiv-2304-13957.title: Decentralized Inference via Capability Type Structures in Cooperative Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv-2304-13957.creator: Charles Jin, Zhang-Wei Hong, Farid Arthaud, Idan Orzech, Martin Rinard
arxiv-2304-13957.description: Abstract This work studies the problem of ad hoc teamwork in teams composed of agents with differing computational capabilities. We consider cooperative multi-player games in which each agent’s policy is constrained by a private capability parameter, and agents with higher capabilities are able to simulate the behavior of agents with lower capabilities (but not vice-versa).

arxiv-2401-14099.title: On a transformation of triple q q -series and Rogers–Hecke type series Thanks: The author was supported in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant No. 12371328) Thanks: 2010 Mathematics Subject Classifications : 05A30, 33D05, 33D15, 32A05, 11E25, 32A10. Thanks: Keywords: q q
arxiv-2401-14099.creator: Zhi-Guo Liu
arxiv-2401-14099.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhi-Guo Liu. Using the method of q q -exponential differential operator we give an extension of the Sears ϕ 3 4 {}_{4}\phi_{3} transformation formula. Based on this extended formula and a q q -series expansion formula for an analytic function around the origin, we present a transformation formula for triple q q -series, which includes several interesting special cases, especially a double q q -series summation formula. Some application of this transformation formula to Rogers–Hecke type series are discussed.

arxiv-2412-07507.title: ConfigX: Modular Configuration for Evolutionary Algorithms via Multitask Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2412-07507.creator: Hongshu Guo, Zeyuan Ma, Jiacheng Chen, Yining Ma, Zhiguang Cao, Xinglin Zhang, Yue-Jiao Gong
arxiv-2412-07507.description: Abstract Recent advances in Meta-learning for Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) have shown the potential of using neural networks to dynamically configure evolutionary algorithms (EAs), enhancing their performance and adaptability across various BBO instances. However, they are often tailored to a specific EA, which limits their generalizability and necessitates retraining or redesigns for different EAs and optimization problems.

arxiv-2502-14354.title: Self-Improvement Towards Pareto Optimality: Mitigating Preference Conflicts in Multi-Objective Alignment
arxiv-2502-14354.creator: Moxin Li, Yuantao Zhang, Wenjie Wang, Wentao Shi, Zhuo Liu, Fuli Feng, Tat-Seng Chua
arxiv-2502-14354.description: Abstract Multi-Objective Alignment (MOA) aims to align LLMs’ responses with multiple human preference objectives, with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) emerging as a prominent approach. However, we find that DPO-based MOA approaches suffer from widespread preference conflicts in the data, where different objectives favor different responses. This results in conflicting optimization directions, hindering the optimization on the Pareto Front.

arxiv-2506-13892.title: Scaling Algorithm Distillation for Continuous Control with Mamba
arxiv-2506-13892.creator: Samuel Beaussant, Mehdi Mounsif
arxiv-2506-13892.description: Abstract Algorithm Distillation (AD) was recently proposed as a new approach to perform In-Context Reinforcement Learning (ICRL) by modeling across-episodic training histories autoregressively with a causal transformer model. However, due to practical limitations induced by the attention mechanism, experiments were bottlenecked by the transformer’s quadratic complexity and limited to simple discrete environments with short time horizons.

arxiv-2508-09251.title: The Interstellar Medium in I Zw 18 seen with JWST/MIRI: I. Highly Ionized Gas Facilities: JWST(MIRI), HST(ACS), Keck(KCWI) Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , Numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , SciPy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , Dustmaps ( Green 2018 )
arxiv-2508-09251.creator: L. K. Hunt, A. Aloisi, M. G. Navarro, R. J. Rickards Vaught, B. T. Draine, A. Adamo, F. Annibali, D. Calzetti, S. Hernandez, B. L. James, M. Mingozzi, R. Schneider, M. Tosi, B. Brandl, M. G. del Valle-Espinosa, F. Donnan, A. S. Hirschauer, M. Meixner, D. Rigopoulou, C. T. Richardson, J. M. Levanti,
arxiv-2508-09251.description: Abstract We present JWST/MIRI spectra from the Medium-Resolution Spectrometer of I Zw 18, a nearby dwarf galaxy with a metallicity of ∼ \sim 3% Solar. Its proximity enables a detailed study of highly ionized gas that can be interpreted in the context of newly discovered high-redshift dwarf galaxies.

pmc-10541385.title: Core and penumbra estimation using deep learning-based AIF in association with clinical measures in computed tomography perfusion (CTP)
pmc-10541385.creator: Sukhdeep Singh Bal, Fan-pei Gloria Yang, Nai-Fang Chi, Jiu Haw Yin, Tao-Jung Wang, Giia Sheun Peng, Ke Chen, Ching-Chi Hsu, Chang-I Chen
pmc-10541385.description: ObjectivesTo investigate whether utilizing a convolutional neural network (CNN)-based arterial input function (AIF) improves the volumetric estimation of core and penumbra in association with clinical measures in stroke patients.MethodsThe study included 160 acute ischemic stroke patients (male = 87, female = 73, median age = 73 years) with approval from the institutional review board.

pmc-10720621.title: K-Means Clustering Coarse-Graining (KMC-CG): A Next Generation Methodology for Determining Optimal Coarse-Grained Mappings of Large Biomolecules
pmc-10720621.creator: Jiangbo Wu, Weizhi Xue, Gregory A. Voth
pmc-10720621.description: Coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics (MD) has become a method of choice for simulating various large scale biomolecular processes; therefore, the systematic definition of the CG mappings for biomolecules remains an important topic. Appropriate CG mappings can significantly enhance the representability of a CG model and improve its ability to capture critical features of large biomolecules.

pmc-11418095.title: Efficacy and safety of an oral complementary medicine combination in people with symptomatic knee osteoarthritis: Protocol for the double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled ATLAS trial
pmc-11418095.creator: Arashi Shahid, Xiaoqian Liu, Karen Bracken, Robin Christensen, Leticia Alle Deveza, Simone Collins, Joanna Harnett, David J. Hunter, Andrew J. McLachlan, Sarah Robbins, Jocelyn L. Bowden
pmc-11418095.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the efficacy and safety of an oral complementary medicine combination formulation relative to placebo, on changes in pain intensity from baseline to week 12, in people with knee osteoarthritis (OA).DesignA placebo-controlled, double-blind, two-arm, superiority, phase II, Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) (ACTRN12623000380695).

pmc-11468214.title: Diverse phenotypes and fertility outcomes of patients with androgen insensitivity syndrome in a Chinese family harboring identical AR gene variant
pmc-11468214.creator: Hao Geng, Dongdong Tang, Kuokuo Li, Chuan Xu, Chao Wang, Xiansheng Zhang, Xiaojin He, Yunxia Cao
pmc-11468214.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundAndrogen insensitivity syndrome (AIS) is a rare genetic disorder characterized by resistance to androgens, mainly due to mutations in the androgen receptor (AR) gene. It can manifest as complete AIS, partial AIS and mild AIS. While there have been studies linking specific AR gene mutations to AIS phenotypes, different clinical AIS phenotypes are also reported in patients with the same AR gene mutation.

pmc-11507553.title: Process Mapping of the Sol–Gel Transition in Acid-Initiated Sodium Silicate Solutions
pmc-11507553.creator: Marzieh Matinfar, John A Nychka, Esmaiel Jabbari
pmc-11507553.description: Fabricating large-scale porous bioactive glass bone scaffolds presents significant challenges. This study aims to develop formable, in situ setting scaffolds with a practical gelation time of about 10 min by mixing 45S5 bioactive glass with sodium silicate (waterglass) and an acid initiator. The effects of pH (2–11), waterglass concentration (15–50 wt.

pmc-11609565.title: MRI Findings of Bilateral Anterior Tarsal Tunnel Syndrome - A Case Report
pmc-11609565.creator: Yi Yan, David Wang, Vishal Kalia, Gregory Garvin
pmc-11609565.description: Anterior tarsal tunnel syndrome, an infrequent entrapment neuropathy involving the deep peroneal nerve beneath the inferior extensor retinaculum in the anterior ankle, is often overlooked on medical images, leading to delayed diagnosis and treatment. We present the case of a 52-year-old male, an avid runner, who exhibited a sensation of burning and tingling in the dorsal region of both feet.

pmc-11690581.title: DESIGNING FOR LATER LIFE: SOCIO-GERONTOLOGICAL INSIGHTS IN CONVERSATIONS WITH AGE-TECH EXPERTS
pmc-11690581.creator: Stephen Katz
pmc-11690581.description: This presentation summarizes original research data based on interview conversations with 11 international experts, consisting of designers, innovators and leaders in the gerontechnological field. Their experiences reveal important insights about the creation, production and distribution of care technologies for older adults, and how priorities are imagined for the future.

pmc-12455158.title: Metastatic Breast Cancer mHealth App to Promote Patient-Provider Communication: Protocol for a Usability and Satisfaction Study
pmc-12455158.creator: Thais F Alves, Kaitlyn Crosby, Ronnie D Horner, Hongying Daisy Dai, Jairam Krishnamurthy, Melanie J Cozad, Javad Sarvestan, Claire Conley, Elizabeth Baker
pmc-12455158.description: BackgroundWith the availability of more advanced and effective treatments, life expectancy has improved among patients with metastatic breast cancer (MBC), but this makes communication with their medical oncologist more complex. Some patients struggle to learn about their therapeutic options and to understand and articulate their preferences.

pmc-12670777.title: Agronomic performance and yield stability of field pea (Pisum sativum L.) genotypes in multi-environment trials
pmc-12670777.creator: Chaoqin Hu, Jie Cun, Alaa A Soliman, Feng Yang, Zeinab E Ghareeb, Xingxing Yuan, Tao Yang, Xuejun Wang, Jijun Zhang, Chao Xiang, Long Zhao, Changyan Liu, Gaoling Luo, Bin Zhou, Xu Zhu, Yongsheng Tang, Ruigang Wang, Haitian Yu, Xin Yang, Yubao Wang, Zhengming Dai, Aiqing Zheng, Qiong Li, Xiuzhi Xia,
pmc-12670777.description: BackgroundThe selection of stable, high-yielding pea genotypes is crucial for sustaining production under changing climate conditions. Twenty multi-environment trials (10 locations x 2 years) were conducted to evaluate 11 genotypes during the 2020–2021 and 2021–2022 growing seasons in southern China.

pmc-12695897.title: 89Zr-anti-CD8 immunoPET visualizes heterogeneous intratumoral CD8+ immune responses to treatment with radiation and anti-CTLA4
pmc-12695897.creator: Elizabeth A. Germino, Kirstin A. Zettlitz, Tyler Watkins, Bao Ying Chen, Deirdre La Placa, Felix B. Salazar, Jennifer Chean, Shichang Li, Heather M. McGee, Terence M. Williams, Anna M. Wu
pmc-12695897.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Anti-CD8 immunoPET facilitates non-invasive, whole-body visualization of immune responses, and syngeneic preclinical models are a crucial tool for studying tumor infiltration of T cells in response to cancer therapies. This study characterized longitudinal CD8+ T cell responses in an orthotopic mouse model of breast cancer treated with radiation and anti-CTLA4 by immunohistochemistry and anti-CD8 immunoPET, confirming an early but heterogeneous response induced by combination treatment that is detectable by imaging.

pmc-12843427.title: Curative Brachytherapy for Inoperable Early-Stage Oesophageal Cancer: A Case Series and Narrative Review
pmc-12843427.creator: Elena Lluzar, Adriana Capdevila, Faegheh Noorian, Antonio Herreros, Cristina Castro, Àngels Gines, Glòria Fernández-Esparrach, Carmen Ares, Yao Qiang, Angeles Rovirosa
pmc-12843427.description: Background: A subset of patients with T1-T2 oesophageal cancer are not candidates for surgery or chemotherapy and have a poor prognosis due to limited treatment options. This study evaluated the combination of external beam radiotherapy (EBRT) and endo-oesophageal brachytherapy (EBT) as a curative treatment in these patients, with cause-specific survival (CSS) and local recurrence-free survival (LRFS) as the primary endpoints.

pmc-12968485.title: Integrating Advanced Practice Nurses in Anesthesia to Tackle Gaps in Current Health Care: A Qualitative Study
pmc-12968485.creator: Luzia Vetter, Balthasar L Hug, Maya Zumstein‐Shaha
pmc-12968485.description: Aging population and growing shortage of specialists present increasing challenges to anesthetic care. In Switzerland, advanced practice nurses in anesthesia are not yet integrated, despite their potential to contribute to innovative care models. This qualitative study explored current gaps in anesthetic care and assessed the potential role of advanced practice nursing in anesthesia.

pmc-13335840.title: Bandgap‐Engineered PtxTey:Ag2Te Composite Quantum Dots Enable Programmable NIR‐II Imaging and Photothermal‐Immune Synergistic Therapy
pmc-13335840.creator: Jing Liu, Rui Xu, Quan Wu, Tian‐Xin Xiao, Lai‐Xi Zhao, Lei Sun, Ya‐Wen Zheng, Liang Dong, Zhi‐Quan Tian, Haibo Wang
pmc-13335840.description: Real‐time monitoring of tumor spatiotemporal dynamics and precise modulation of the tumor immune microenvironment are pivotal for effective cancer treatment. However, current platforms lack the ability to integrate quantitative molecular imaging with spatially confined immune modulation. Here, we report a nanotheranostic platform Pt2Te3:Ag2Te‐αPD‐L1 (PAPD) based on bandgap‐engineered PtxTey:Ag2Te quantum dots.

pmc-13475830.title: Surgical repair in coexisting transposition of the great arteries with infracardiac obstructed total anomalous pulmonary venous connection
pmc-13475830.creator: Amitabh Satsangi, Pratik K Jha, Sandeep Chakraborty, Akshay Kumar Bisoi
pmc-13475830.description: Coexisting transposition of the great arteries (d-TGA) and total anomalous pulmonary venous connection (TAPVC) is a rare combination, with the infracardiac variety being more rare. So far, only a few cases are described in the literature with combined infracardiac TAPVC and d-TGA. We present a 4-month-old girl having TGA and obstructed infracardiac TAPVC with early left ventricle mass regression.

pmc-13500312.title: Impact of compounded financial collapse and armed conflict on access to radiation therapy in Lebanon: lessons for building resilient cancer care systems in fragile settings
pmc-13500312.creator: Caroline Samaha Jabbour, Layth Mula-Hussain, Yavuz Anacak, Fadi El-Karak, Georges Fares, Toufic Eid, Hady Ghanem, Maria Pia Ibrahim, Christelle Saad, Maroun Khater
pmc-13500312.description: BackgroundLebanon’s radiation therapy (RT) system has been exposed to successive, overlapping crises since 2019, including financial collapse, the Beirut Port explosion, and armed conflict in 2024. This study analyzes the impact of compounded crises on RT access and practice patterns using longitudinal institutional data from Mount Lebanon Hospital (MLH) as a sentinel cohort.

pmc-13572713.title: Goreisan-mediated suppression of chemokine and cytokine production in astrocytes under AQP4-expressing conditions
pmc-13572713.creator: Kazuhito Murakami, Tomofumi Shimizu, Toshitaka Kido, Yoichiro Isohama
pmc-13572713.description: AimAquaporin-4 (AQP4), predominantly expressed in astrocytes, has been implicated in neuroinflammation through the amplification of cytokine and chemokine production. Goreisan (GRS), a traditional Japanese herbal medicine, modulates AQP4-related water homeostasis. However, its effects on AQP4-associated inflammatory processes remain unclear. This study aimed to elucidate the anti-inflammatory effects of GRS, with particular emphasis on inflammatory responses observed under AQP4-expressing conditions.

pmc-13679933.title: From roadmap to action: A pathway toward enhanced resilience in the U.S. beef value chain
pmc-13679933.creator: Samantha J Werth, Reba L Colin, Douglas J Goodwin, Hugh Aljoe
pmc-13679933.description: Graphical Abstract Graphical AbstractFor image description, please refer to the figure legend and surrounding text. Keywords: collaboration, data interoperability, decision-support tools, funding mechanisms, sustainability indicators A coordinated, cross‑sector research collaborative is essential to translate sustainability priorities into scalable, real‑world outcomes across the U.S. beef value chain.
